# PDF Archive

> > PDF Archive is a professional document hosting and archiving platform offering secure file sharing, storage, and collaboration tools since 2010.

PDF Archive provides comprehensive document management solutions including secure cloud storage, private collaboration networks, file transfer services, and PDF processing tools. The platform emphasizes security with AES encryption and GDPR compliance while supporting multiple file formats and advanced features like dynamic QR code generation.

## Key Topics

- Document Hosting
- Secure Archive

- Document Management

## Core Services

- [PDF Archive - Professional document hosting](https://www.pdf-archive.com): PDF Archive homepage: professional document hosting, archiving, sharing since 2010
- [Secure Archive - Personal and Corporate](https://www.pdf-archive.com/services/secure-archive): Secure archive service with AES encryption for personal and corporate documents
- [Private Social Network](https://www.pdf-archive.com/services/private-social-network): Private social network for secure document sharing and business collaboration
- [Public Document Sharing](https://www.pdf-archive.com/services/public-sharings): Public document sharing via custom URLs with embedded PDF reader and social sharing
- [File Receiving Service](https://www.pdf-archive.com/services/receive-files): File upload and receiving service for secure document transfer without account

## Tools & Features

- [Online PDF Toolbox](https://www.pdf-archive.com/services/pdf-toolbox): Online PDF tools: conversion, repair, splitting, metadata editing, image extraction
- [Permanent QR Codes](https://www.pdf-archive.com/services/permanent-qr-codes): Dynamic QR code generation for marketing, business cards, and product packaging

## Account & Subscription

- [Premium Account](https://www.pdf-archive.com/services/premium-account): Premium subscription plans with storage, file sharing, and advanced features
